Two genuinely delivered unanswered subject raises still retire, explicit death clears the marker, and organic revival remains live.
An existing unknown-capture watermark still protects affected subject/category markers without another capture call while allowing newer observable silence.

A quiet owner DM posts once in the same thread, reserves cadence, records the category, and stores the evidence-bearing history.
The catch-up-shaped wrapper that returns void only after Slack resolves still records confirmed delivery.
Two local timers for one person reserve synchronously; only one sends and only one attempt is recorded.
MPIM/channel, new inbound, failed work reply, compose/gate/unavailable, and empty-format paths remain unsent and unreserved.

surfaces.reason: The picker control verifies the owner row remains independently eligible while the colleague attempt is reserved. Owner DM success, rejection, explicit failure, concurrency, and no-retry state execute.

All accounting cases use an identified colleague person row and real social store state. Confirmed colleague DM posts and mirrors only the delivered wire sentence; the same shared send boundary is used for rejected sends.

The accounting API exists for the Slack coda's 1:1 DM send boundary; dependent SlackMaster evidence executes the actual transport callback. The coda's only eligible surface is a 1:1 DM; live and catch-up-shaped response forms execute.
Social codas are suppressed before accounting on non-1:1 surfaces; this package changes no room path. MPIM and channel inputs are deterministically suppressed before composition or accounting.

Both unavailable capture evidence and an unconfirmed transport outcome preserve uncertainty without extra calls or a retry. Cadence/activity/composer/gate failures fail closed before reservation; Slack throw and explicit unsuccessful acknowledgement retain only the attempt cap.
